## Custom Site — Argus Media

First instance of the **Custom Site — <Label>** naming convention.

Receives URLs from an external Argus scraper and posts them to content-sourcing's `/research-ingest` with `source_type: "Website"`. Dedup, classification, persistence inherit from the existing pipeline.

**Standard tail (copy-paste for new custom-site workflows):**
1. Validate (host allow-list, https-only, dedup)
2. Build /research-ingest payload
3. POST /research-ingest (httpBearerAuth + retry + onError→error branch)
4. Respond (success or 502 with upstream status)

When N≥3 custom-site workflows exist, extract the tail into an Execute Workflow subworkflow.
